quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black lettering or symbols. They warn drivers about hazards or special situations ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns of a pedestrian crosswalk. When you see this sign, slow down and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed on roads near schools. It tells drivers to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the road ahead?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve. The road curves to the right, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns of an upcoming curve to the right.

questions.question: What message appears on this yellow pennant-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped yellow signs mark a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a low ground railroad crossing. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or catch on the tracks at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign forbids right turns. You cannot make a right turn at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about motorist services, such as rest areas, food, or hospitals nearby.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging onto the road from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead. Watch for people crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: If you approach a flashing red traffic light, you should:

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Treat a flashing red light like a stop sign. Stop completely at the stop line or before the crosswalk. Yield to all other traffic and pedestrians before going.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely handle these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the right lane is ending soon. Move to the left lane to avoid traffic problems.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead becomes a divided highway. Stay to the right side of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a lane is ending. Get ready to merge safely with traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond-shaped warning sign tells you the road may be slippery when wet. Slow down and be careful because your car may be hard to control.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic lights, red is always on top and green is always on the bottom. On horizontal lights, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction and maintenance areas. They help drivers and pedestrians stay safe. Traffic fines can double in these work zones.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A side road is coming up ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A side road is coming up ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you to watch for a side road intersecting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves right and then left.
The road ahead curves left and then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right and then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you that the road curves to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is coming. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for trains to pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the curve.
Slow down to 35 mph or less before the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to 35 mph or less before the curve.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs tell you about road conditions ahead. Speed advisory signs show the safe speed for the upcoming curve.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs with black markings are regulatory signs. You must obey them. This sign means passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to slow down and let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a roundabout ahead. Slow down and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: An orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle means:
questions.explanation: Farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back to show they are slow-moving.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to road conditions ahead. This sign warns you about winding curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A downgrade or hill is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A downgrade or hill is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep or long hill ahead. The hill may have sharp curves.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs warn you that you are approaching a school zone or school crossing. Stay alert and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is coming.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always stop completely at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Get ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop at a yield sign if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming and you should be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What is this symbol used for?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it travels slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork machines, or horse-drawn wagons. During the day it looks like a solid orange triangle. At night it looks like a hollow red triangle.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is allowed on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a bright yellow-green background. These signs warn about upcoming conditions like curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. They show rules that drivers must follow. This sign tells you to keep right to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a traffic signal is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. They show rules that drivers must follow. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a side road intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells you a school zone is ahead. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, what should you do?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Be alert and stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a lane for left turns only from either direction. You cannot use this lane for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop. Wait for any vehicles or pedestrians to clear before you proceed.

questions.question: What is the biggest concern when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will be misaligned because one side of your car is higher than the other.
You might damage a tire if you drift onto the shoulder.
Your car might hydroplane if the shoulder is wet.
You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road ahead. If one wheel drops onto a low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. You must turn around and find another way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is ahead. Check your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers of work zones and dangerous conditions. This sign tells you construction is ahead. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let them in safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic may merge into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that move slowly.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows an intersection ahead where a road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal. It tells drivers turning left on green that they do not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a merge ahead. Two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What is this bicyclist signaling?
questions.explanation: Bicycles do not have turn signals. Bicyclists use hand and arm signals to tell other drivers what they plan to do. A straight left arm means the bicyclist is turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You may see this sign at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided highway. Traffic now flows in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic can only go in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down at the intersection. Be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign alerts you that the right lane is ending. Get ready for merging traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two-way traffic is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction the arrow points. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful. You do not have to stop completely.

questions.question: What must you do when you see an octagonal sign?
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop. Yield to traffic and pedestrians with the right-of-way. Then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. The sign is placed a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road splits into two directions. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Triangle signs pointing downward mean yield. Slow down when you see this sign. Stop if needed at a marked line.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws that you must follow. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are only for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction shown.
These lanes are for buses and carpool vehicles only.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are only for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.

Trucks are on the upcoming hill.

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic will soon combine into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has turns or curves.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or turns, and stay farther from other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This circular sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crosswalk is ahead.

options.text: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road will curve right first, then curve left. Slow down to safely navigate the curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Wet pavement is slippery and dangerous. This sign warns you of road conditions that can cause you to lose control. Slow down on wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
